Jailer 2 Box Office Day 17: Rajinikanth Starrer Crosses Rs 790 Crore Worldwide

Rajinikanth-starrer 'Jailer 2' continued its theatrical run on its seventeenth day, registering notable collections across domestic and international markets, according to industry reports compiled by Sacnilk.

Domestic and Worldwide Earnings

On Saturday, the film reportedly collected Rs 9.35 crore net in India, marking a 70% increase compared to the previous day's earnings of Rs 5.50 crore. This latest addition brings its total domestic net collection to Rs 444.75 crore, with the India gross reaching Rs 520.35 crore. Internationally, the film added Rs 3 crore on Day 17, pushing its overseas gross to Rs 270.50 crore. Consequently, the worldwide gross collection is reported to have reached Rs 790.85 crore.

Ticket sales data indicates that 'Jailer 2' ran across 8,738 shows in India on Saturday, with an estimated 6,92,764 tickets sold, bringing the cumulative ticket count to over 3 crore across its run.

Language-Wise Performance and Occupancy

  • Tamil: The Tamil version remained the primary contributor, earning Rs 6.70 crore from 4,199 shows. It registered an overall occupancy of 30.37%, peaking at 42.54% during night screenings.
  • Hindi: The Hindi screenings brought in Rs 1.45 crore across 3,549 shows, recording an overall occupancy of 15.28%.
  • Telugu: Telugu shows contributed Rs 90 lakh from 801 shows, achieving an overall occupancy of 23.28%.
  • Kannada: The Kannada version added Rs 30 lakh across 189 shows.

Geographically, Tamil Nadu led the state-wise contributions on Saturday with Rs 5.25 crore, followed by Karnataka with Rs 2 crore, Kerala and the Telugu states (Andhra Pradesh and Telangana) contributing Rs 1 crore each.

Comparison With 'Coolie'

Industry tracking comparisons with Rajinikanth's previous release, 'Coolie', indicate a notable variance in performance at the same point in their respective theatrical runs. At a comparable stage, 'Coolie' had reportedly accumulated a domestic net collection of Rs 276 crore and a worldwide gross of Rs 499.40 crore, whereas 'Jailer 2' stands at significantly higher totals.

Verification and Limitations

Readers should note that box office figures are compiled from tracking agencies and public industry sources and are considered approximate. Official studio figures may vary. Verification of these statistics can be pursued through trade analysts, official studio press releases, and entertainment tracking portals.
